notes.subject: (Nuhu ka ji sumaya)
notes.rationale: Mabul is Hebrew for the Flood; bracketed Bambara gloss supplied at first mention so the reader knows which flood.

notes.subject: למבול
notes.gloss: 'at the Flood' (JPS: sat enthroned AT the flood) vs 'upon the flood' (KJV) — lamed of time or of location.

notes.subject: כבוד→Kaboya
notes.gloss: not here; see v9 note — כבוד is 'weight/heaviness', Kaboya carries 'renown' not the physical weight.

translation: Yawe sigilen tun don Mabul (Nuhu ka ji sumaya) kan; Yawe, masakɛ, sigilen bɛ fo tile bɛɛ.
